correctness.rationale: The proof determines the projective column multiplicities of every parity-check matrix from the published [8,2,6]_3 dual parameters, then counts syndrome representations over every extension field. Distinct line pairs remain bases after scalar extension; deep syndromes force both coefficients nonzero; same-line supports cannot contribute. Thus each of six line pairs contributes exactly four physical supports, giving 24. The standalone GF(9) replay independently reproduces the finite anchor and source table.

originality.rationale: The primary source explicitly leaves the all-m value \(\lambda_{8,m}=24\) as a conjecture after checking \(m=2\) and \(m=3\). The new statement proves that exact all-parameter value by a projective-column/syndrome argument. Targeted semantic and web searches found the conjecture itself and unrelated deep-hole or covering results, but no source covering the all-m D5 claim. Current and prior private ledgers were searched for the source identifier, D5/APMCF terminology, and equivalent multiplicity language without a matching claim.
residual_risks: An equivalent proof could exist under different terminology in literature not surfaced by the targeted searches.
The result does not address the D3 or D4 branches of the same conjecture.

The constant 24 has a field-independent geometric explanation and removes all higher-lift uncertainty for the D5 family.
